what: Step text passes beside the pinned photo panel. Each time the bottom edge of the text block touches the bottom edge of the photo panel, that step’s photo pushes up from below by the panel height and covers it (.8s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)). The previous photo is pushed up only 11rem over the same duration and dims to brightness .5. Scrolling back up reverses the direction, so the photo comes down from above and covers.

options.shift: Distance the outgoing photo is pushed (CSS length), default 11rem

note: The consumer applies position: sticky to the photo panel’s wrapper. The original measures position every frame while visible, on top of Lenis, instead of using window scroll events — this part does the same
